intro: Make every seat at the table feel special. With a tall cushioned back, easy-to-clean PVC seat, and wood frame, Mangum chairs bring you comfort and elegance that lasts through every gathering.

features.title: Relax through every course
features.text: High-density foam cushioning on the seat and back lets you stay comfortable from quick breakfasts to long festive dinners with friends and family.

features.title: Upright support you can feel
features.text: The tall cushioned backrest supports your posture naturally, so you don’t feel the strain even after hours of sitting and socializing.

features.title: Built for daily family life
features.text: Solid rubberwood construction in a deep espresso shade gives you sturdy chairs that stand up to everyday meals and weekend entertaining.

features.title: Easy-care PVC leatherette seat
features.text: The beige PVC seat is not only soft but also easy to wipe clean, making it practical for homes with kids, parties, or frequent use.

features.title: Espresso elegance for your décor
features.text: The warm espresso finish adds depth and sophistication, blending seamlessly with both light and dark dining tables.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Mangum Synthetic Leather Dining Chair Set Of 2
